d:
Finally Irisviel was able to meet with Kiritsugu again.
"Kiritsugu..." she began to cry.
"What is wrong Iris?"
"I am pregnant!" she hold a positive pregnancy test. "But it's not yours! It's-!"
Kiritsugu kissed her. "It's okay. I know. We will figure this out....I love you Iris."
"Kiritsugu....I love you!"
Soon after they had sex inside the Emiya residence shed.
